rubric_items.reason: All six acceptance criteria and the column content (date, doctor) map to REQ-1..REQ-13; non-asks (calling patients, sorting, patient page table) are listed under Out of scope with reasons.
Most REQs are atomic and checkable (search and status combination split into REQ-9/REQ-10), but REQ-11 bundles page size and filtered total; REQ-7 leaves 'today' time zone implicit.
Every known status cites the ticket, baseline, data model or an IDE answer; the one assumption (REQ-3) was confirmed in A-04; no invented values.
No ticket/baseline clash found; the glossary gap on 'visit' and the 12-month measure were raised as questions and answered (A-01..A-03); data-protection baseline carried into REQ-12.
Three questions plus one assumption check, each with real options and a proposed default, all answered in the IDE; none asks something the context pack already answers.
Plain wording; glossary terms Completed, Medical history and Front-desk staff used consistently; missing 'Last visit' term flagged.

findings.text: REQ-11 is compound: it combines two checkable behaviours, the page size staying 20 with the filter on and the total counting only filtered patients, in one requirement.

cites.quote: still pages at `20 per page` and its total counts only the filtered patients

findings.suggested_fix: Split into one REQ for page size 20 under the filter and one REQ for total reflecting only filtered patients, both citing ticket L28 and context/conventions.md#lists.

findings.text: REQ-7 states the last-visit date is hospital-local but not that 'today' is the hospital-local date, which the architecture fixes; the boundary for a 29 February today is also undefined.

cites.quote: before the same calendar date 12 months before today
Availability, slots and "today" use the hospital time zone

findings.suggested_fix: Say 'today in Asia/Kolkata' in REQ-7 and state how a non-existent same date (29 February) maps, e.g. to 28 February.
